narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

rina.instruct: Three excited young women shouting a surprise at a party, loud, bright and joyful.

diana.instruct: Calm, flat, very serious young businesswoman, deadpan and precise, slightly annoyed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It's 3:15, and your Capricorn friend's calendar says LAUGH.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She laughs exactly once, then gets back to work.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Diana. Ambitious, reliable, and always working.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her five-year plan has its own five-year plan.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She's twenty-six, and she already has a retirement fund.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her friends love her. They just never see her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Her last vacation was a work trip with a pool.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So they plan a surprise party in a meeting room.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Diana walks in with her laptop, ready to present.

lines.speaker: rina
lines.text: Surprise!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The confetti cannon hits her right in the face.

lines.speaker: diana
lines.text: This was not in my calendar.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside a Capricorn?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a mountain with a ladder labelled GOALS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ladder has no top, and she's still climbing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the bottom, a stamp marked APPROVED, covered in dust.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's a dial labelled FUN, and it's set to two.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a laptop that never, ever closes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But here's her secret. She keeps every birthday card.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They're all in a folder labelled IMPORTANT.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Diana stays for exactly one hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then she books the next party for October.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She sends everyone a calendar invite.
